title: Unit 3 第四课时 基础达标与综合拓展

sections.title: 一、语音练习
sections.instruction: 选出画线字母发音与所给音标一致的选项。

questions.translation: 选出画线字母发音与音标 /ə/ 一致的选项。
questions.explanation: across中的首字母a在非重读音节中发弱读短元音 /ə/；bookcase中的oo发/ʊ/；change中的a发/eɪ/。根据参考答案选 across。

questions.translation: 选出画线字母发音与音标 /ɒ/ 一致的选项。
questions.explanation: office中的o在闭音节中发短元音 /ɒ/；go中的o发双元音/əʊ/；son中的o发短元音/ʌ/；handsome中的o发弱读元音/ə/。故选 <u>o</u>ffice。

questions.translation: 选出画线字母发音与音标 /eɪ/ 一致的选项。
questions.explanation: raise中的ai发双元音 /eɪ/；activity中的a发/æ/；screen中的ee发/iː/；hike中的i发/aɪ/。故选 r<u>ai</u>se。

questions.translation: 选出画线字母发音与音标 /ɪŋ/ 一致的选项。
questions.explanation: pink中的in在/k/前发音为 /ɪŋ/；violin和twin中的in发/ɪn/。故选 p<u>in</u>k。

sections.title: 二、连词成句
sections.instruction: 将所给词语连成一句话，注意大小写和标点符号。

questions.prompt: fun, school, sounds, your (.)
questions.translation: 你们的学校听起来很有趣。
questions.explanation: 主系表句型：主语“Your school” + 系动词“sounds” + 表语“fun”，句末用句号。

questions.prompt: Peter's, how, yours, to, school, similar, is (?)
questions.answer: How is Peter's school similar to yours?
questions.translation: 彼得的学校和你的学校有什么相似之处？
questions.explanation: 特殊疑问句：疑问词“How” + 系动词“is” + 主语“Peter's school” + 表语短语“similar to yours”，句末用问号。

questions.prompt: Monday, flag, the, we, raise, every (.)
questions.answer: Every Monday we raise the flag.
accept: Every Monday we raise the flag.
We raise the flag every Monday.
questions.translation: 每周一我们都举行升旗仪式。
questions.explanation: 主谓宾状结构：时间状语“Every Monday” + 主语“we” + 谓语“raise” + 宾语“the flag”，句末用句号。

sections.title: 三、根据所给提示填写单词
sections.instruction: 根据汉语或首字母提示，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。

questions.prompt: 1. The Bird's Nest (鸟巢) is a famous ______ (现代的) building in China.
questions.translation: 鸟巢是中国著名的现代化建筑。
questions.explanation: 形容词modern意为“现代的，当代的”。故选 modern。

questions.prompt: 2. I like this picture very much. It is an ______ (令人惊叹的) work of art.
questions.translation: 我非常喜欢这幅画。它是一件令人惊叹的艺术作品。
questions.explanation: 不定冠词an后接以元音音素开头的形容词amazing（令人惊叹的），修饰名词work。故选 amazing。

questions.prompt: 3. Our national f______ is red, with five yellow stars.
questions.translation: 我们的国旗是红色的，上面有五颗黄色的星星。
questions.explanation: national flag为固定表达，意为“国旗”。根据首字母f可知填flag。故选 flag。

questions.prompt: 4. Their house is s______ to ours, but ours is much bigger.
questions.translation: 他们的房子和我们的相似，但是我们的要大得多。
questions.explanation: be similar to为固定短语，意为“与……相似”。根据首字母s可知填similar。故选 similar。

questions.prompt: 5. Your eating habits are not so good. You need to c______ them.
questions.translation: 你的饮食习惯不太好。你需要改变它们。
questions.explanation: need to do sth. 后接动词原形，根据首字母c和语境可知为change（改变）。故选 change。

sections.title: 四、用方框内所给词的适当形式填空
sections.instruction: 从方框中选择恰当的单词并用其适当形式填空，每词限用一次。

questions.prompt: 1. Tom, how about ______ some beautiful cards to our friends on Children's Day?
questions.translation: 汤姆，儿童节给我们朋友寄一些漂亮的卡片怎么样？
questions.explanation: How about doing sth. 后接动名词sending（寄，发送）。故选 send。

questions.prompt: 2. I spent ______ of the time in learning.
questions.translation: 我把大部分时间花在了学习上。
questions.explanation: most of the time意为“大部分时间”。故选 most。

questions.prompt: 3. Something is wrong with my bicycle. May I use ______?
questions.translation: 我的自行车出故障了。我可以用你的吗？
questions.explanation: 此处指代“你的自行车”，用名词性物主代词yours。故选 you。

questions.prompt: 4. We must ______ our hands when we answer the questions in class.
questions.translation: 在课堂上回答问题时我们必须举手。
questions.explanation: 情态动词must后接动词原形raise（举起），raise one's hand意为“举手”。故选 raise。

questions.prompt:
5. What do you think of this piece of music?
—It ______ beautiful but a little sad.
questions.translation:
你觉得这首音乐怎么样？
——它听起来很美，但有点悲伤。
questions.explanation: 主语It为第三人称单数，表示听觉系动词用sounds。故选 sound。

sections.title: 五、用括号内所给词的适当形式填空
sections.instruction: 根据句子语法与句意，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出正确的一项。

questions.prompt: 1. In Chinese families, people won't start dinner until the elders take their ______ (sit).
questions.translation: 在中国家庭中，直到长辈们入座，大家才会开饭。
questions.explanation: take one's seat为固定搭配，意为“就座”。主语the elders为复数，名词用复数seats。故选 seats。

questions.prompt:
2. My parents work in Yongzhou. What about ______ (you)?
—They work in Guangzhou. I'm going to visit them this summer holiday.
questions.translation:
我的父母在永州工作。你的父母呢？
——他们在广州工作。
questions.explanation: 此处What about yours指代“你的父母（your parents）”，需要用名词性物主代词yours。故选 yours。

questions.prompt: 3. He spends ______ (much) of the time in playing computer games every day.
questions.translation: 他每天把大部分时间花在玩电脑游戏上。
questions.explanation: most of the time意为“大部分时间”，much的最高级形式为most。故选 most。

questions.prompt: 4. Are you ______ to see the ______ (amaze) painting?
questions.translation: 看到那幅令人惊叹的画作你感到惊奇吗？
questions.explanation: 第一空主语为you（人），表示人感到惊讶用amazed；第二空修饰painting（物），表示令人惊叹的用amazing。故选 amazed; amazing。

questions.prompt: 5. Thanks for ______ (send) emails to me.
questions.translation: 谢谢你给我发电子邮件。
questions.explanation: Thanks for doing sth. 为固定句型，介词for后接动名词sending。故选 sending。

sections.title: 六、句型转换
sections.instruction: 按要求完成下列句子变换，从每小题所给的选项中选出正确的一项。

questions.prompt:
1. They are late for school because they get up late. (对画线部分 because they get up late 提问)
______ ______ they late for school?
questions.translation: 他们为什么上学迟到了？
questions.explanation: 对because引导的原因状语提问，疑问词用Why，后接一般疑问语序are they。故选 Why are。

questions.prompt:
2. She is 13 years old. (对画线部分 13 years old 提问)
______ ______ is she?
questions.translation: 她多大了？
questions.explanation: 对年龄13 years old提问，疑问短语用How old。故选 How old。

questions.prompt:
3. The weather is very cold in winter in Shenyang. (对画线部分 very cold 提问)
______ ______ the weather ______ in winter in Shenyang?
questions.translation: 沈阳冬天的天气怎么样？
questions.explanation: 询问天气句型为“What is the weather like...?”。故选 What is; like。

questions.prompt:
4. Lily has her dancing lessons once a week. (对画线部分 once a week 提问)
______ ______ does Lily have her dancing lessons?
questions.translation: 莉莉多久上一次舞蹈课？
questions.explanation: 对频率once a week提问，疑问短语用How often。故选 How often。

questions.prompt:
5. He takes a bus to school every day. (改为同义句)
He goes to school ______ ______ every day.
questions.translation: 他每天乘公共汽车去上学。
questions.explanation: take a bus to... 的同义表达为 go to... by bus。故选 by bus。

sections.title: 七、阅读理解
sections.instruction: 阅读房屋出租广告海报，从每小题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
# A house for rent (出租) for 1,500 yuan per month

**Rooms:** a living room, three bedrooms, two washing rooms and a kitchen

**EV (家电):** a fridge (冰箱), a washing machine, a TV, four air-conditions (空调), the Internet

**Neighbourhood:**
- A garden in front of the building.
- Trees on both sides of the road.
- A parking lot (停车场) behind the building.
- A hospital near the neighbourhood.
- 8 minutes by bus, 15 minutes on foot to a big supermarket for vegetables and fresh fruit.
- A big bookstore on the right.
- No. 1 Middle School on the left.

Contact Mr. Black at 0716-8523-5678.

questions.prompt: 1. The house doesn't have ______.
questions.translation: 这栋房子没有______。
questions.explanation: 根据Rooms列表中列出的“a living room, three bedrooms, two washing rooms and a kitchen”可知，没有书房（a study）。故选 a study。

questions.prompt: 2. Which of the following is NOT TRUE?
options: The building is in front of a parking lot.
There is a hospital near the neighbourhood.
You can buy vegetables and fruit easily.
It takes you 15 minutes on foot to the big bookstore.
questions.translation: 下列哪一项陈述是不正确的？
questions.explanation: 文中指出步行15分钟到达的是大型超市（big supermarket），而不是大书店。故选 It takes you 15 minutes on foot to the big bookstore.。

questions.prompt: 3. Mr. Smith wants to rent the house for a year. He needs to pay ______.
questions.translation: 史密斯先生想租这栋房子一年。他需要支付多少钱？

questions.prompt: 4. This passage is a(n) ______.
questions.translation: 这篇文章是一则______。
questions.explanation: 文章为房屋出租广告（advertisement）。故选 advertisement。

sections.title: 八、完形填空
sections.instruction: 通读短文，从每小题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage: We have a big playground in our school. We all like to [1] games there after school. It's Friday. We only have two classes [2] the afternoon. When school is over, a lot of students and teachers go to the playground. Look! The boys of Grade Two are [3] a basketball match. Some girls are [4] it and shouting (大叫). On the other side of the playground, many [5] are playing football. Football is their favourite [6]. They can teach well, and they can play football well, too. How about Li Ming, Li Lei and Wei Fang? They are students of Grade One. They are playing [7]. They are in the school volleyball team and they play it really well. They [8] win! It's half past five now. It's time to [9]. The students all leave the playground. We are happy because tomorrow is a [10] Saturday.

questions.translation: 放学后我们都喜欢在那里玩游戏。
questions.explanation: play games为固定短语，意为“玩游戏”。故选 play。

questions.translation: 我们下午只有两节课。
questions.explanation: 在下午固定介词短语为in the afternoon。故选 in。

questions.translation: 二年级的男生正在进行一场篮球比赛。
questions.explanation: have a basketball match为固定短语，意为“进行一场篮球比赛”。故选 having。

questions.translation: 一些女生在观看比赛并大声呐喊助威。
questions.explanation: 观看体育比赛用动词watch。故选 watching。

questions.translation: 操场的另一边，许多老师正在踢足球。
questions.explanation: 根据后一句“They can teach well...”可知主体是老师（teachers）。故选 teachers。

questions.translation: 足球是他们最喜爱的运动。
questions.explanation: football属于体育运动（sport）。故选 sport。

questions.translation: 他们正在打排球。
questions.explanation: 根据后一句“They are in the school volleyball team...”可知他们正在打排球（volleyball）。故选 volleyball。

questions.translation: 他们总是能赢！
questions.explanation: 前句指出他们排球打得极好（play it really well），因此总是能获胜（always win）。故选 always。

questions.translation: 该回家了。
questions.explanation: 根据“It's half past five now... The students all leave the playground.”可知到了该回家（go home）的时间了。故选 go home。

questions.translation: 我们很高兴，因为明天是一个令人轻松的周六。
questions.explanation: 修饰事物Saturday应用以-ing结尾的形容词relaxing（令人轻松的）。故选 relaxing。

sections.title: 九、语篇填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项填入空白处，使短文通顺完整。
sections.passage: I am Kate from England. I study in Yucai Middle School. I like my school very much because there [1] (be) all kinds of interesting clubs here. I like to [2] (sing) to, so I want to join the singing club. I think [3] (it) is relaxing for me. But my friend Li Mei [4] (not) like singing. She is good [5] (at) speaking English, and she wants to join the English club because she wants to [6] (talk) with people in English. And it can help her practice her spoken English. Bob wants to join the [7] (soccer) club. He can play soccer and he is really good at it. [8] (What/How) about Jane? She can tell [9] (story) very well, so she wants to join the story-telling club. [10] (Do) you want to join us?

questions.translation: 因为这里有各种各样有趣的社团。
questions.explanation: there be句型中，主语all kinds of interesting clubs为复数，be动词用are。故选 are。

questions.translation: 我也喜欢唱歌，所以我想加入歌唱社团。
questions.explanation: like to do sth. 后接动词原形sing。故选 sing。

questions.translation: 我认为唱歌对我来说很放松。
questions.explanation: 指代上文提到的singing这件事，主语用代词it。故选 it。

questions.translation: 但是我的朋友李梅不喜欢唱歌。
questions.explanation: 主语my friend Li Mei为第三人称单数，一般现在时实义动词like的否定形式借助助动词doesn't。故选 doesn't。

questions.translation: 她擅长讲英语……
questions.explanation: be good at为固定短语，意为“擅长于……”。故选 at。

questions.translation: 因为她想用英语与人们交流。
questions.explanation: talk with sb. 为固定搭配，意为“与某人交谈/交涉”。故选 talk。

questions.translation: 鲍勃想加入足球社团。
questions.explanation: 根据后一句“He can play soccer...”可知加入的是足球社团（soccer club）。故选 soccer。

questions.translation: 简呢？
questions.explanation: What about / How about为固定疑问句型，意为“……怎么样/呢？”。句首首字母大写。故选 What / How。

questions.translation: 她很会讲故事，所以她想加入讲故事社团。
questions.explanation: tell stories为固定短语，意为“讲故事”。故选 stories。

questions.translation: 你想加入我们吗？
questions.explanation: 主语you后接实义动词want，一般疑问句借助助动词Do。句首首字母大写。故选 Do。

sections.title: 十、真题演练 (阅读理解)
sections.instruction: 阅读下列失物招领启事，从每小题所给的 A、B、C 三个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
# LOST!
**Lost:** My pen
**Last seen:** In Room 2216 on Monday afternoon.
**Description:** Long, thin, pointy, black ink, with my name on the body.
**Contact:** Bill, 896-4523.
Thank you!

---

# REWARD!
Please help me find my blue wallet! Contact Gina at 268-5893. $10 reward!
Thank you!

---

# REWARD!
**LOST PET**
Male, two years old, teddy. Last seen on November 23rd, in the area of Main Street. Please call Linda at 825-1145 if you find him! $20 reward!
Thank you!

---

# Have You Seen This Mug?
My yellow and white mug was lost at Creative Services kitchen on Friday morning. If found, please wash and return to Creative Services kitchen, or call Jason at 555-6896. Thank you!
*Mug, if you can read this, please come home! I miss you!*

questions.prompt: 1. Where was the pen last seen?
options: In the area of Main Street.
questions.translation: 钢笔最后是在哪里被看到的？
questions.explanation: 根据第一则启事“Last seen: In Room 2216 on Monday afternoon.”可知在2216房间。故选 In Room 2216.。

questions.prompt: 2. What was lost on November 23rd?
questions.translation: 11月23日丢失了什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第三则启事“LOST PET... Last seen on November 23rd...”可知丢失的是一只宠物（A pet）。故选 A pet.。

questions.prompt: 3. Why does Jason say "please come home"?
options: Because the mug is very expensive.
Because Jason wants to wash the mug.
questions.translation: 为什么杰森说“请回家吧”？
questions.explanation: 杰森把杯子拟人化并写道“I miss you!”，表达了他对这个杯子的喜爱与珍惜。故选 Because Jason loves the mug.。

questions.prompt: 4. What is the main purpose of these notices?
options: To tell people some interesting stories.
To help the owners find their lost things.
To show people how to write lost-and-found notices.
questions.translation: 这些启事的主要目的是什么？
questions.explanation: 四则启事均为寻物/寻宠启事，主要目的是帮助失主找回丢失的物品或宠物。故选 To help the owners find their lost things.。
